name: qubika-livecoding-local
description: Local marketplace hosting the Qubika Livecoding plugin from this project directory

plugins.name: qubika-livecoding
plugins.description: Standardized Data Analyst interview kit: live SQL exercises (embedded DuckDB, ephemeral public link, Ctrl+C kills it), pre-call CV and screening-notes prep, and a post-call assessment written from the transcript and the live SQL log against a shared template and DASRI/DASRII criteria, plus a browser-only two-exercise SQL screener the recruiting team runs from chat before any of it. One plugin, for every interviewer.
